PAKISTAN ANIMAL
QUARANTINE (IMPORT AND EXPORT OF ANIMALS AND ANIMAL PRODUCTS) (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1985
An Ordinance
further to amend the Pakistan Animal Quarantine (import and Export of Animals and Animal Products) Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of
Pakistan. Extraordinary, Part I, 13th March, 1985]
No. F. 17 (1)/85-Pub.-The
following Ordinance, made by the President, is hereby published for general
information :-
1. Short title and commencement.-(1) This Ordinance may be called the Pakistan Animal Quarantine (Import
and Export of Animals and Animal Products) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1985.
(2) It shall come into force at
once,

ORDINANCE, 1985
An Ordinance
further to amend the Pakistan Animal Quarantine (import and Export of Animals and Animal Products) Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of
Pakistan. Extraordinary, Part I, 13th March, 1985]
No. F. 17 (1)/85-Pub.-The
following Ordinance, made by the President, is hereby published for general
information :-
2. Amendment of section 10, Ordinance XLIX of 1979.--In the
Pakistan Animal Quarantine (Import and Export of Animals and Animal Products)
Ordinance, 1979 (XLIX of 1979), in section 10, in subsection (1), for the
full-stop at the end a colon :hall be substituted and thereafter the following
proviso shall be added, namely :--
"Provided
that no order on such revision shall be passed unless the applicant has been
given an opportunity of being heard."
